title: Vocal and musical emotion perception, voice cue discrimination, and quality of life in cochlear implant users with and without acoustic hearing
summary: This study aims to provide a comprehensive picture of auditory emotion perception in cochlear implant (CI) users by (1) investigating emotion categorisation in both vocal (pseudo-speech) and musical domains and (2) how individual differences in residual acoustic hearing, sensitivity to voice cues (voice pitch, vocal tract length), and quality of life (QoL) might be associated with vocal emotion perception and, going a step further, also with musical emotion perception. In 28 adult CI users, with or without self-reported acoustic hearing, we showed that sensitivity (d’) scores for emotion categorisation varied largely across the participants, in line with previous research. However, within participants, the d’ scores for vocal and musical emotion categorisation were significantly correlated, indicating both similar processing of auditory emotional cues across the pseudo-speech and music domains as well as robustness of the tests. Only for musical emotion perception, emotion d’ scores were higher in implant users with residual acoustic hearing compared to no acoustic hearing. The voice pitch perception did not significantly correlate with emotion categorisation in either domain, while the vocal tract length significantly correlated in both domains. For QoL, only the sub-domain of Speech production ability, but not the overall QoL scores, correlated with vocal emotion categorisation, partially supporting previous findings. Taken together, results indicate that auditory emotion perception is challenging for some CI users, possibly a consequence of how available the emotion-related cues are via electric hearing. Improving these cues, either via rehabilitation or training, may also help auditory emotion perception in CI users.

标题：人工耳蜗使用者（伴有或不伴有声学听力）的语音与音乐情绪感知、声音线索辨别及生活质量
摘要：本研究旨在全面描绘人工耳蜗（CI）使用者的听觉情绪感知状况，具体包括：（1）考察其在语音（伪言语）和音乐两个领域中的情绪归类表现；（2）探讨残余声学听力、对声音线索（嗓音音高、声道长度）的敏感性以及生活质量（QoL）的个体差异如何与语音情绪感知相关联，并进一步延伸至音乐情绪感知。研究纳入28名成年CI使用者（伴有或不伴有自报的声学听力），结果显示：情绪归类的敏感性（d'）得分在参与者之间差异较大，这与既往研究一致。然而在个体内部，语音与音乐情绪归类的d'得分显著相关，表明伪言语和音乐两个领域对听觉情绪线索的处理具有相似性，同时也说明测验具有稳健性。仅在音乐情绪感知方面，伴有残余声学听力的植入者其情绪d'得分高于无 acoustic hearing 者。嗓音音高感知与两个领域的情绪归类均无显著相关，而声道长度则在两个领域均呈显著相关。在生活质量方面，仅言语产生能力这一子领域（而非总体QoL得分）与语音情绪归类相关，部分支持了既往发现。综上，结果表明听觉情绪感知对部分CI使用者而言具有挑战性，这可能与情绪相关线索通过电听觉获取的可及性有关。改善这些线索（无论是通过康复还是训练）或有助于提升CI使用者的听觉情绪感知。
关键词：人工耳蜗；情绪感知；嗓音线索；音乐情绪；生活质量
